topic: Fixing the campaign report reach graph
summary_markdown:
The primary topic is updating and fixing the 'Reach' graph within the campaign report. Multiple participants noted that clients are complaining about this specific metric/graph.

One participant mentioned setting a task to fix the Reach graph, noting it needs to be addressed for both the current and old Reach formulas due to high client inquiry volume.
[me] committed to working on the report, stating they would analyze the period and values, and collaborate with others on how to handle the 'shelves' (полочкам) displayed on the graph.
decisions: The Reach graph in the campaign report needs fixing for both old and new formulas.
action_items: [me] will work on analyzing the period and values of the report data.
[me] will collaborate with others to determine how to handle specific elements ('shelves') on the graph.
